node.title: Re^2: backticks and system() (Updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Actually, [doc://system] with a single string argument comes closer to qx// than the system LIST form (with LIST having more than one element), qx// has no built-in "list" form which avoids the shell like system LIST does. That's why I think the two commands as shown in the question should be pretty much equivalent; there's probably some information missing from the question, like maybe differing PATH settings, or maybe the command strings aren't exactly as shown, or something like that.
